summary.tldr: Limits which managers or confidential labour-relations staff can be used as replacement workers during strikes or lockouts under the Canada Labour Code.
what_it_does: Replaces paragraph 94(4)(c) of the Canada Labour Code.
Bars an employer, during a strike or lockout, from using certain managers or confidential industrial-relations staff from another workplace to do the work of employees in the bargaining unit.
summary.background: The bill amends the Canada Labour Code rules on replacement workers during strikes and lockouts.
